notes.title: 📢 2023.02 Update: Added Easy Mode, etc.
notes.notes:
Hello Big Rabbits!
We are here to inform you about the February update.

1. Addition of Easy Mode
First of all, "Easy Mode" has been updated for players who are new or unfamiliar with platformers!
By choosing "Easy Mode", you can explore the world and the story more comfortably.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39294784/b08df149aac7cf7daef5072bfe460005870f96e0.gif

There are two difficulties: "Normal Mode" and "Easy Mode".
You can choose one of the two when starting the game or selecting an empty save slot for the first time.
※ The default difficulty for Early Access is "Normal Mode".

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39294784/742480df2ac1f89d5f5f774ae060eb67762567c8.png

You can also go to ESC -> Settings to change the difficulty.
※ Even for a save slot that was created before the update, the difficulty mode can be changed in-game.



2. Etc.
- Chapter 3 has been improved with the addition/editing of scenarios.
(Particularly in Chapters 1 and 2, detailed scenario improvements have been made to more clearly indicate that Jose knows the human language.)
- Some background resources in Chapter 1 have been modified/added.
- Various character animations have been added, including Talki preening its wings and Jose reading a book.
The name of a specific flower has been changed.
("Mulle" was changed to "Everwish".)
- Interactive elements have been added to the prologue and Chapter 3.
(Added a dropped book at the entrance to Jose's room in the prologue and added a book to the ancient burrow library in Chapter 3.)
- After experiencing an episode, a pop-up appears with a photocard covering the screen.


Studio Doodal will continue to work hard to improve user experience.

We welcome any reports of relevant bugs and issues through the comments section of the related notice, the Steam discussion page, or our email address (studiodoodal@gmail.com).

notes.title: 📢 2022.12 Update : Added 'Piece Map' function!
notes.notes:
221231 Update : Added 'Piece Map' function!

Hello Big Rabbits,
There was an important update for December!

The 'Piece Map' function for seed collection has been updated!
Open the 'Piece Map' on the Liebe Note.
You can return to the area where you played in the past to acquire the seeds you missed and some collectables.
Refer to the Piece Map UI and Seed page to get all the seeds you missed!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39294784/850eeb4428ca044451c0b33ee676bc19e80dea71.gif

※ In addition to seeds, you can acquire missing collectable elements that appear on the platform.
※ Collectables obtained by chatting with friends in special circumstances cannot be obtained.


Detailed description
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39294784/0dbd2bc055b56b6bc0b82dd200a8143f9a57da8e.jpg
- The seeds you have just acquired are marked in pink, the seeds you have already acquired are marked in white, and the seeds you have not acquired are marked in brown.
- You can only enter the 'Piece Map' that you have completed.
- If you want to return to the present in the 'Piece Map', please open Liebe Note and click the 'Piece Map' that is currently in progress.
- If the progress is reversed, it will automatically return to the present.


If there are bugs on the ‘Piece Map’ system, please tell us.
Steam discussions, SNS, e-mail(studiodoodal@gmail.com) etc.

.
.
.

Happy New Year!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39294784/897cf39707a2b48233e69be8e11f3c6da0433aec.jpg

notes.title: [PATCH NOTES Ver.1.0.11.0]
notes.notes:
Hello, It's Studio Doodal.
Share the LAPIN Steam update note about ver.1.0.11.0.

* In the case of Xbox, we will upload patch note on SNS to prevent confusion between steam updates.
  Please check the account below.
  Twitter @StudioDoodal



PATCH NOTES

221122 ver.1.0.11.0

- Chapter 2, Modify the area where the exit is blocked when you die after seeing the flower. If you go up to the left, blocked platforms will become transparent and you can escape the situation.

- Chapter 2, Fixed infinite dash bug of LightRollip.
- Chapter 3, Fixed opend door bug that skipping an elevator up by operating a simple pulley scene, elevator platforming proceeds with the elevator door open. It should be closed.
- Chapter 3, Landforms modification to allow Iffa to play her part during elevator platforming even if in low computer specifications.
- Chapter 3, Fixed a bug that could exit the elevator platform to the left exit and were trapped in a Rabbitinium.
- Controller D-Pad support.
- Modify the sensitivity of the left stick on the controller.



We are very sorry for the bug in playing LAPIN.
We will try our best to fix the bugs that are not mentioned on this update note as soon as possible.
Please feel free to let us know through SNS, email, Steam discussion page, etc.

Thank you.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39294784/443b299ed825edac8d75b9e06c674f13d874e55b.gif
